description: Start the full visibility audit: site speed, agent readiness, and Open Service Profile conformance, plus the paid engines when their inputs are given. city enables AI visibility. placeId enables local rank. Provide businessName and state for accurate identification. If the paid budget cannot cover this request, nothing starts; use the individual free tools. For a running result, wait pollAfterSeconds, then call get_audit_report with runId. Repeat while status is running. Cached completed results need no polling.

businessName.description: Business name as it appears on Google.

city.description: City. Needed for the AI visibility check.

placeId.description: Google Place id. Needed for the local rank grid.

state.description: US state, two-letter code or full name.

trade.description: Trade, for example hvac, plumbing, auto repair, marine. Optional; inferred when omitted.

url.description: Website URL, http or https. The scheme is optional.

name: start_audit
